Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. About the role:
We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer who's passionate about building reliable, scalable infrastructure that helps developers ship better software faster. You'll design and maintain our Kubernetes-based multi-cloud platform, improve our monitoring and observability tools, and collaborate with product and engineering teams to solve real problems in real time. This is a role where you'll own the systems that power Camunda, drive automation that raises the bar for everyone, and mentor others who want to do the same. If you thrive on building things that work well and don't break when they shouldn't, we'd love to talk.
What You’ll Be Doing:
• 
Design and maintain our infrastructure – You'll evolve our Kubernetes-based, multi-cloud platform architecture, ensuring it's available, scalable, and fault-tolerant. You'll establish configuration best practices and network services that our teams rely on.
• 
Build observability that matters – Implement and improve monitoring and alerting tools that give both SREs and developers real visibility into system health and performance. Make it easy for teams to understand what's happening across our stack.
• 
Own your systems end-to-end – You'll adopt a "you build it, you run it" mentality, which means participating in on-call rotations and being the go-to person when things need quick fixes. You'll create runbooks and automation that turn complex problems into manageable processes.
• 
Ship features and improvements with product teams – Work cross-functionally with product engineering, product management, and support to define and deliver features that move the needle. Bring your expertise to the table early and often.
• 
Push automation to the next level – Identify repetitive work and automate it away. Share what you learn with your teammates so everyone gets better at their craft. We measure progress by the quality of our systems, not hours worked.
• 
Be the expert others learn from – Help less experienced engineers tackle complex infrastructure challenges. Break down technical problems into clear steps and support others in growing their skills. 
What You Bring:
Must Haves:
• 
Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes – You've built, deployed, and maintained Kubernetes clusters in production environments. You understand how to manage workloads, networking, and storage at scale.
• 
Infrastructure as code expertise – You're fluent in tools like Terraform (or similar IaC tools) and know how to version, test, and safely deploy infrastructure changes.
• 
Demonstrated experience in monitoring and observability – You've worked with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms to instrument systems and alert on what matters.
• 
Strong 3rd-level support and incident response skills – You've responded to production incidents, diagnosed complex issues, and communicated clearly with stakeholders under pressure. You understand root cause analysis and how to prevent issues from happening again.
• 
A passion for automation and raising the quality bar – You see manual work as a problem to be solved. You care deeply about building systems that are reliable, maintainable, and easy to understand.
• 
Responsible use of AI tools – You leverage AI for research, code review, documentation, test generation, and automation to improve your effectiveness. You know how to validate AI outputs against requirements, never share confidential or personal data with AI systems without authorization, and always retain human accountability for decisions and deliverables.
 Nice-to-haves:
• 
Experience with major cloud providers – You've worked with AWS (EKS), Google Cloud Platform (GKE), or similar managed Kubernetes services.
• 
ArgoCD or GitOps workflows – You've used declarative, Git-driven infrastructure management to keep systems in sync.
• 
Proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages – You write scripts and automation tools that solve real problems.
• 
Experience with SLOs and alerting frameworks – You've helped teams define meaningful service level objectives and set up alerts that don't cry wolf.

What We're Researching
We're running a paid study on go-to-market strategies tailored to independent retail operations. Specifically, we are evaluating a new appointment management tool designed for independent bicycle repair shops. This research helps us refine our initial product positioning and identify hidden risks before launch.
How It Works
You will complete an asynchronous, remote review of a short go-to-market brief. During this task, you will read through our target audience assumptions, proposed messaging, and launch plan. Next, you will write a short report that clearly separates unsubstantiated assumptions from hard evidence. Finally, you will recommend one low-cost validation step to test our riskiest assumption without conducting new market outreach.
Who This Is For
We welcome Product Marketing Managers, GTM Strategists, and early-stage Product Managers with experience in retail software or small business tools. Candidates should have a strong grasp of market validation techniques and startup strategy. Familiarity with independent bike shops or local service businesses is a strong plus, though not strictly required.

Identify and separate unproven assumptions from backed evidence within the document

Write a concise written report summarizing your strategic findings

Professional experience in product marketing, go-to-market strategy, or product management

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
SUPPORT OPERATIONS SYSTEMS LEAD
We're hiring a Support Operations Systems Lead to help own the systems, workflows, and operating rhythms that keep User Operations running reliably at scale. This is a hands-on technical support operations role for someone who can move fluidly between live triage of our projects, backlog management of internal requests, systems health, stakeholder communication, and end-to-end program ownership. You'll work across ticketing workflows, routing logic, queue health, labeling taxonomy, escalation paths, workforce signals, and internal tooling requests. The ideal person is more technical than a traditional operations lead, more hands-on than a traditional TPM, and less software-engineering-heavy than a dedicated SWE.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
• 
Own day-to-day operations for core support systems, including ticketing workflows, routing, queues, labels, taxonomy, escalations, and related tooling; triage urgent operational issues as they arise, especially when system behavior, workforce distribution, queue health, or SLA risk looks off
• 
Manage intake, prioritization, and follow-through for systems requests from support managers, TSEs, operations leads, engineering, product, and other internal teams
• 
Help maintain the team's roadmap by distinguishing one-off fixes from broader system improvements, surfacing recurring pain points, and pushing back on low-leverage work
• 
Drive smaller technical and operational programs end-to-end, being responsible for discovery, scoping and execution, rollout, documentation and success metrics
• 
Partner with engineering, data, IT, and support leaders to debug issues, validate changes, improve monitoring, and prevent repeat failures
• 
Use SpaceXSI and AI-native workflows to reduce manual toil, investigate issues, summarize signals, draft documentation, test changes, and improve how the team operates
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
• 
Experience in support operations, systems operations, technical program management, or a similarly cross-functional technical systems role
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
• 
Experience working with operational systems such as ticketing platforms, routing workflows, queue configuration, labels/taxonomies, dashboards, Slack workflows, and internal tools
• 
Technical skills to investigate system issues, read configuration or code, and partner effectively with engineers
• 
Excellent at triage and prioritization: when several things are broken or ambiguous, you can quickly determine what is urgent, what needs investigation, what needs escalation, and what should become a longer-term fix
• 
Able to own work end to end: clarify the problem, align stakeholders, sequence the work, communicate tradeoffs, launch safely, and measure whether the change worked
• 
Comfortable pushing back thoughtfully and can tell stakeholders "not yet," "not this way," or "this should be part of a broader fix" while maintaining trust
• 
Energized by a role that blends firefighting with systems-building, and you have a strong bias toward action, clarity, and continuous improvement

Remote role (United States)

$118,000 - $145,000 USD

d9301a220206dde8.description: CloudCrane lets a person ask their assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, or any that connects to MCP) for a small app (a habit tracker, a spending log, a packing list) and have it land on their phone's home screen. The assistant writes the app and publishes it through our MCP server; we check it, keep every version, and serve it at its own address, where it installs, opens full screen and works offline. What the person saves stays on their phone. This role owns whole slices of that, not tickets. You'll take something that is still a sentence ("an update must never lose what someone saved") through the MCP tools, the service, the database, the apps host and the tests until it holds on a real phone. **What you'll do** - Build and extend the app MCP: the tools an assistant sees, what each grant may do, and the errors that tell an assistant how to fix what it sent - Own the checks an app passes before it's published, and the warnings kept with each version - Keep the apps host honest: one answer per address, worked out once and served the same here and at the edge - Review others' work for correctness, races and the failure modes a passing test suite misses **What we need** - Five or more years building production backends, with real ownership of something that had users - TypeScript at depth, or another statically typed language you'd pick this up from quickly - Strong SQL, and a reason for every place you'd enforce a rule in the database instead of in code - You write tests as part of building, and can say what each one would catch - You've debugged a race condition in production and can describe how you proved the fix **Nice to have** - You've built against the Model Context Protocol, or another protocol strangers' clients call - Progressive web apps, service workers and their update edge cases - Cloudflare Workers or another edge runtime **How we hire:** a 30-minute call about something you've built; a working session on a real problem from this codebase; a conversation about decisions when the evidence is thin; references, then an offer. No puzzles, no unpaid project work, and we aim to answer within a week at every stage. More: https://cloudcrane.ai/careers/senior-software-engineer/

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

Headquarters: Remote, United States

About Calm

Calm is the leading mental health brand on a mission to make the world happier and healthier. Known for its flagship consumer app—ranked #1 in its category with over 180 million downloads and availability in ten languages across 190 countries—Calm helps people sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully through content and tools from experts and beloved celebrity voices. Building on this foundation, Calm has created a broader portfolio including evidence-based solutions like Calm Health, offered through employers, health plans and providers, designed to expand access to mental health and sleep support, boost benefits engagement, and drive positive health outcomes. Today, Calm supports more than 3,500 organizations and reaches over 42 million covered lives through Calm Health. Calm has been recognized as a TIME100 Most Influential Company and one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter. Learn more at calm.com.
What We Do

We build Calm’s product, guide Calm’s analysis, secure Calm’s data, and operate the platforms that underpin it all. We’re product-minded, team-oriented, and grounded in the mission of meeting everyone where they’re at on their mental health journey. We work in fast-moving, small pods, and as an SDET you’ll make sure what we ship is reliable, well-tested, and ready for the millions of people who rely on Calm.

What You’ll Do

Millions of people rely on Calm every day, and you’ll help make sure every release earns their trust. As an SDET, you’ll build the automation and pipeline checks that catch issues early, lead our QA efforts, and partner with engineering, product, and design to ship the Calm app and our internal tools with confidence.

Specifically, you will:

• Set the testing strategy and quality bar for the Calm app and our internal content and admin tools

• Architect and build automated test frameworks and suites (UI, API, mobile, and integration) that run reliably in our CI/CD pipelines

• Review requirements, specs, and pull requests early so issues are caught in-sprint rather than at the end

• Work with all of our consumer product teams on release planning and certification, and monitor release health after launch

• Partner with product and design (roughly 30% of your time) to define acceptance criteria and keep release timelines on track

• Manage and direct our offshore QA team, shifting their work toward automation and higher-value testing over time

• Triage and document defects with clear, actionable detail, and drive them to resolution

• Track and report on quality metrics such as coverage, flakiness, escaped defects, and release stability

• Use AI-assisted tooling to speed up test creation, maintenance, and analysis

• Contribute to feature development in Android, iOS, backend, or web as the role grows

Who You Are

• 3+ years of experience as a software engineer, SDET, or QA automation engineer

• Strong programming skills in Java and JavaScript/TypeScript

• Hands-on experience building test automation frameworks and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines

• Experience testing mobile apps (iOS and/or Android)

• Experience leading QA efforts and owning release readiness, ideally with distributed or offshore teams

• Comfortable using AI-assisted tools in your testing and development workflow

Nice to Haves

• Experience with a consumer subscription or mobile app at scale

• Hands-on development experience in a mobile, backend, or web codebase

Minimum Requirements

• 3+ years of related experience

As an Enterprise Support Specialist on the Customer Operations & Support team, you’ll have the opportunity to partner closely with the Enterprise Support Manager to define and elevate our Enterprise Support function. This team is responsible for crafting what exceptional support looks like for Figma's most strategic customers. You will be delivering the kind of experiences that build trust throughout the Figma community, from customers to key internal partners, such as Sales, Product, and Engineering.

We're looking for a technical support expert experienced in working with B2B Enterprise-level customers with an ability to understand and help with their unique needs. You will diagnose issues, determine solutions, and anticipate customer impact, serving as a customer advocate while working cross functionally to deliver an exceptional experience. The work you do will span over technical product, account administration and billing. This role requires coverage during non-standard business hours to support global customers.

Coverage outside standard business hours is part of this role. The shift days and hours for this role will be Wednesday to Sunday, 11.30pm IST - 8.30am IST.

This role will be held from our Bengaluru office (in Koramangala) on a hybrid basis.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Develop expertise of Figma's products and the journey of our customers, from Product Designers to Account Administrators, to accurately diagnose sophisticated inquiries
  • Interact with Figma customers daily via email, taking ownership over cases from start to resolution
  • Partner closely with Sales teams to guide large scale organizations through complex workspace configurations, acting quickly to address technical issues and ensuring successful account setup

  • Act as designated point of contact for high-risk escalations and issues, proactively engaging the appropriate partners, and owning communication through to solution
  • Identify trends and communicate insights to our Product and Engineering teams to advocate for bug fixes, process improvements, and feature enhancements
  • Engage in pilot programs and experimentation to identify efficient approaches for delivering fast and personalized interactions to meet performance expectations and customer commitments
  • Recommend foundational tooling and processes in partnership with our Product Support Operations teams to ensure we are set up to scale

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 2+ years of experience in a technical SaaS Support environment, ideally supporting Enterprise customers
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting SAML/SSO and SCIM configurations for large-scale organizations
  • Familiarity with system administration for large end-user communities or guiding customers through complex implementations
  • Ability to assess the business impact of technical issues to drive cross-functional alignment, prioritization, and timely resolution

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Skilled in using tools such as Adobe XD, Sketch, and/or Framer and a passion for UX/UI development  
  • Familiarity and willingness to learn AI concepts (e.g., prompt refinement, natural language tools, generative AI, machine learning basics)

At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

Engagement Management is a new and fast-growing practice at ClickUp, and it's quickly becoming central to how we serve our enterprise customers. Our EMs bring program leadership, service delivery and change management together in one role. As a ClickUp Senior Engagement Manager you will lead the formation and orchestration of post-sale strategy and execution for the company’s largest and most strategic clients. We're looking for someone hungry, who excels in building, and who takes genuine pride in the quality of their work.

Here, Engagement Managers are the single point of accountability for outcomes. You own everything between the contract being signed and the client seeing measurable results: what was sold gets delivered, on time and on margin, and we can prove it worked.

You'll lead enterprise SaaS implementations across the full engagement lifecycle, from shaping scope in pre-sales, mobilizing the team and delivery, go-live, stabilization and a clean handover to the account team. You'll run work-stream programs with Paid TAMs, AI specialists, Product and Engineering, and the client's own project team, and you'll be the trusted advisor to the client's executive sponsor.
 
Simply put: you are the single point of accountability for delivery, the client's partner in getting value from ClickUp, and a thought leader for how we deliver.
 
Your role
• 
Stakeholder Management
• 
Serve as the primary client contact for delivery
• 
Build strong relationships with stakeholders while ensuring delivery remains aligned to client objectives and contractual commitments.
• 
Build trusted relationships with client executive sponsors and program leads at VP and C-level, acting as their primary point of contact for delivery.
• 
Navigate complex enterprise stakeholder environments and competing priorities across client functions (IT, PMO, business sponsors, procurement) and broker alignment when they conflict.
• 
Project Delivery Oversight
• 
Deliver engagements against agreed scope, schedule, hours budget and quality, using rigorous change control to protect timelines and delivery margin.
• 
Translate customer business requirements into internal deliverables and milestones
• 
Own engagement governance, including kickoffs, weekly working sessions, sponsor check-ins and SteerCos, and provide clear, concise status reporting to clients and internal stakeholders.
• 
Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, fostering a collaborative, accountable and high-performing delivery culture while providing coaching, direction and support.
• 
Proactively manage risks, issues and dependencies through the RAID log, and act as the primary escalation point.
• 
Manage engagement financials, including hours burn, forecasting, utilisation and margin, flagging overrun risk early and agreeing recovery plans.
• 
Drive AI adoption
• 
Guide clients from manual workflows to AI-assisted and agent-driven operations, and own post-go-live adoption outcomes.
• 
Drive Value and Business Outcomes
• 
Identify expansion opportunities through delivery and co-sell with Account Executives, bringing the delivery credibility that secures follow-on work.
• 
Establish a value baseline before configuration begins, track benefits through go-live, and produce the value assessment that underpins renewal and expansion.
• 
Governance
• 
Design and run governance mechanisms
• 
Track delivery efficacy, timelines, value realization and customer experience
• 
Create continuous-improvement mechanisms
• 
Change Management & Communication
• 
Own communications around delivery status, risks and outcomes
• 
Manage escalation and communication across customer/internal teams
• 
Assess change readiness and resistance across impacted teams; build sponsor and champion networks to carry the rollout.
• 
Design the communications and enablement plan with the client, and sequence go-live to match the organization's capacity for change.
• 
Role Development
• 
Contribute to building the Engagement Management practice by iterating on templates, playbooks and AI workflows that make every engagement faster and more consistent.
 
Your skills and experience
• 
5+ years of software and/or services delivery experience, with at least 2 years as the accountable project, program or engagement lead.
• 
Proven track record taking enterprise SaaS deployments from kickoff through go-live and into adoption, ideally in work management, PSA, CRM, ITSM or collaboration platforms.
• 
Strong grasp of SaaS implementation fundamentals: workspace and data architecture, permissions and SSO, integrations, data migration, change management and enablement. No coding required, but you can challenge an unrealistic technical scope.
• 
Comfortable with Agile, Waterfall and hybrid delivery, and knowing which one the client actually needs.
• 
Commercial acumen: you've managed engagement budgets, SoWs, change requests and margin, and you know when to push for expansion vs when to stabilize.
• 
Executive presence: you can run a SteerCo, deliver bad news early with a recovery plan, and hold a line on scope with a CIO in the room.
• 
Experience leading cross-functional and distributed teams you don't directly manage, across client, partner and internal resources.
• 
Strategic judgment to separate genuine product gaps from client process or training gaps.
• 
Hands-on with AI: you already use AI to work faster, and you can credibly advise clients on where agents and automation fit.
• 
Excellent written and verbal communication. Status reports people actually read.
 
Nice to have: Experience in work management or SaaS software, professional services firms, agencies or regulated industries. PMP Certification.
 
What you'll love about working here
•

d952ed028a87cbdc.description:
About the Role
• We are looking for an experienced Vice President - Investment Banking to take a leadership role in managing M&A and private capital transactions for SMEs and mid-market companies.
• The VP will play a central role in transaction execution, seller onboarding, buyer and investor engagement, stakeholder management, and team leadership. 
• This is a hands-on leadership position suited to an experienced deal professional who can independently manage multiple live transactions while mentoring analysts and associates.

Key Responsibilities
Transaction Execution
• Lead the execution of live M&A, capital raising, and corporate finance transactions
• Manage end-to-end transaction timelines, workstreams, and deal processes
• Coordinate with clients, buyers, investors, lawyers, advisers, and other stakeholders
• Identify and resolve transaction bottlenecks and execution risks
• Drive transactions toward successful completion
• Maintain strong execution discipline across multiple concurrent mandates

Seller Onboarding & Client Management
• Engage with prospective sellers, founders, and business owners
• Assess transaction readiness and suitability of potential mandates
• Guide clients through onboarding, preparation, and transaction processes
• Maintain regular communication with clients throughout the deal lifecycle
• Ensure expectations, timelines, and deliverables are effectively managed

Buyer & Investor Engagement
• Support buyer and investor identification, outreach, and engagement
• Facilitate introductions between sellers, strategic buyers, investors, and relevant stakeholders
• Coordinate transaction discussions and follow-ups
• Maintain momentum across buyer and investor conversations throughout the deal process

Team Leadership
• Manage and mentor analysts, associates, and other execution professionals
• Allocate transaction workstreams and oversee team deliverables
• Review financial analysis, transaction materials, research, and other work products
• Maintain high standards of accuracy and quality
• Improve internal transaction processes, workflows, and execution efficiency
• Support the development of junior investment banking professionals

Requirements
• 7+ years of relevant experience in M&A execution, investment banking, transaction advisory, corporate finance, private equity, or corporate development
• Demonstrated involvement in completed M&A, capital raising, or corporate finance transactions
• Experience independently managing multiple live transactions and transaction workstreams
• Experience managing, reviewing, or mentoring analysts and associates
• Strong understanding of M&A processes, transaction execution, and stakeholder coordination
• Prior transaction exposure across Southeast Asia or other international markets would be preferred
• Strong project management and stakeholder management capabilities
• Excellent communication, analytical, and leadership skills
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, transaction-driven environment

Compensation
Competitive fixed compensation along with a performance-linked bonus based on individual, team, and transaction outcomes.

Career Opportunity
• The successful candidate will have the opportunity to take significant ownership of transaction execution, build and mentor a growing deal team, improve execution processes, and contribute directly to the long-term growth of the investment banking platform.
• This role offers strong career progression for an ambitious investment banking professional seeking broader deal ownership, leadership responsibility, and international transaction exposure.
